answer: The voyage register is checked at draw time, violet lists the eligible set, and onyx seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 46 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 46 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 288 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
